name: National Scholarship Portal - Post Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: The Post Matric Scholarship Scheme provides financial assistance to students from SC, ST, and OBC categories pursuing higher education after Class 10. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to SC/ST/OBC students studying in Classes 11 and 12, and pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary studies to enable them to complete their education.

custom_criteria.education_level: Must be studying in Class 11 or above

benefits.description: Maintenance allowance ranging from ₹380 to ₹1200 per month depending on course. Additional reimbursement for tuition fees, study tours, thesis typing, book allowance up to ₹5000-50000 annually based on course type

documents_required.name: Income Certificate
documents_required.description: Family income certificate (must be below ₹2.5 lakh annually)

steps: Login and select 'Post Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC'
Fill application form with personal, academic, and bank details
Upload all required documents (PDF format, max 200KB each)
Scholarship disbursed directly to bank account after approval

success_stories: Over 50 lakh students receive scholarships annually worth ₹8000 crore
